01 / Beliefs

What do Fundamental Baptists believe?

These are common teachings in the Fundamental Baptist tradition. For the San Isidro congregation’s own statement of faith, contact the church directly.

01

The authority of Scripture

God inspired the Bible, and it is the final authority for Christian faith and practice.

2 Timothy 3:16–17

02

The person and work of Jesus Christ

Jesus Christ is fully God and fully human. He died for sins, rose bodily from the dead, and will return.

John 1:1, 14 · 1 Corinthians 15:3–4 · Acts 1:11

03

Salvation by grace through faith

Salvation is God’s gift, received through faith in Jesus Christ. Good works follow faith.

Ephesians 2:8–10

Explore the Bible

The Old Testament follows God’s covenant with Israel. The New Testament recounts the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus and the growth of the early church.

  • The Bible
  • Summary and History of the Bible

02 / Practices

Life in a Baptist church

Learn about two ordinances and the role of the local congregation.

Believer’s baptism

After professing faith in Christ, believers are baptized by immersion, publicly identifying with his death, burial, and resurrection. Romans 6:3–4

The Lord’s Supper

The congregation shares bread and the cup in remembrance of Jesus’ death. 1 Corinthians 11:23–26

The local congregation

Baptist congregations typically govern their own affairs under Christ. They gather for worship, prayer, Scripture teaching, and fellowship, and share the gospel through evangelism and missions. Acts 2:42 · Matthew 28:18–20

Further reading Baptist Bible Seminary & Institute and Baptist Bible Fellowship International.
